title: #WeAreNATO - The Romanian Search & Rescue dog master, Social Media version
description:
The touching bond between Marin-Viorel and his dog Nord and their daily job in the Romanian Search & Rescue team.

Meet the men and women who work every day for NATO. From soldiers to scientists, cyber experts to civilian emergency responders, NATO members are committed to supporting and protecting each other.

Marin-Viorel Porosanu and his dog Nord work for the Romanian Urban Search & Rescue Team. Porosanu invited us to film him while training his dog to obey and to search victims that would be stuck, wounded or unconscious during a NATO disaster response exercise in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

transcript.text: The worst part in working with dogs is that they don't live long enough.
As I was small kid, I loved dogs.
I said this, I have to do for my life.
For 21 years I'm doing this and I will do it for 100 more.
These guys are doing this for thousands of years.
They are very good at that.
For now there is no machine to take their place.
We've been through a lot of adventures together.
The dog must have complete confidence in me.
I will be his pack and to trust me, like his pack, like one of his own.
